angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 630,304 km at 213.24 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.6895 +/- 0.0143 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 213.24 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.906 +/- 0.026 solar radii from Gillon et al. 2010, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of CoRoT-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract): 630,304 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.96 +/- 0.08 solar masses from Gillon et al. 2010, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of CoRoT-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5625 +/- 120 K from Gillon et al. 2010, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of CoRoT-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gillon et al. 2010, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of CoRoT-2 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/corot-2.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.506, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CoRoT-2: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-2 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.04 dex, from Southworth 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012MNRAS.426.1291S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-2 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.13055, from Baluev et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015MNRAS.450.3101B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-2 (pscomppars): age 2.7 Gyr, from Gillon et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-2 (pscomppars): rotation period 4.522 d, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of CoRoT-2 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 10.87 km/s, from Gillon et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A&A...511A...3G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
